config.dynamicfps.enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable Dynamic FPS frame rate and audio reduction.
config.dynamicfps.ignore_initial_click_t: Ignore accidental mouse clicks during the first 10 ms after refocusing the game window.
config.dynamicfps.idle_time_tooltip: Minutes without input before activating the Idle state while focused (0 disables).
config.dynamicfps.idle_condition_tooltip: When Dynamic FPS activates the Idle state.
config.dynamicfps.volume_transition_up_t: Rate per second at which sound volume returns when focusing (10.0 = immediate).
config.dynamicfps.volume_transition_down: Rate per second at which sound volume fades when unfocusing (10.0 = immediate).
config.dynamicfps.unfocused_fps_tooltip: Maximum FPS while another window is focused (260 = unlimited).
config.dynamicfps.unfocused_show_toasts_: Whether to show toast notifications while unfocused.
config.dynamicfps.invisible_fps_tooltip: Maximum FPS while minimized (0 requests minimum supported FPS; 260 = unlimited).
config.dynamicfps.invisible_show_toasts_: Whether to show toast notifications while minimized.
config.dynamicfps.hovered_fps_tooltip: Maximum FPS when hovering an unfocused window (260 = unlimited).
config.dynamicfps.hovered_show_toasts_to: Whether to show toast notifications while hovered.
config.dynamicfps.abandoned_fps_tooltip: Maximum FPS while the player is idle (260 = unlimited).
config.dynamicfps.abandoned_show_toasts_: Whether to show toast notifications while idle.
config.dynamicfps.unplugged_fps_tooltip: Maximum FPS while focused on battery power (260 = unlimited).
config.dynamicfps.battery_tracker_toolti: Enable battery monitoring, HUD indicator, notifications, and On Battery state.
config.dynamicfps.battery_tracker_switch: Automatically activate the On Battery power state when discharging.
config.dynamicfps.battery_tracker_notifi: Show toast notifications when charging status changes or battery reaches critical level.
config.dynamicfps.battery_indicator_cond: When to show the battery charge indicator on the HUD.
config.dynamicfps.battery_indicator_debu: Whether the battery indicator stays visible while the F3 debug overlay is open.
config.dynamicfps.battery_indicator_plac: Screen corner where the HUD battery indicator is drawn.
config.dynamicfps.mock_battery_data_tool: Simulate a battery for testing battery state, HUD indicator, and notifications.
